title: New Balance Official Website
text: I worked on Flash development and animation for New Balance’s corporate website. The site covered the company’s products and the people and places behind them, including American manufacturing, factory locations, and community initiatives. The site gave visitors different ways to explore the company beyond its product range.
summary: For New Balance’s corporate website, I worked on Flash development and animation to present its products, manufacturing story, and community initiatives through interactive content.
